text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While brainstorming a new training plan, I 
hit a total roadblock...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
…………"Observed" the dissipation of "COTT." 
"Entropy" is constantly increasing…….

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, won't you 'gaze at the stars' 
with Neo Universe?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It's "astronomical observation". 
There are "visions" that can only be 
perceived at this very moment... so many 
of them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“What a straightforward invitation. I 
usually have to search for the hidden 
meaning behind her words, so I was glad to 
understand it right away.”

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Sphira— Routing to coordinates... via 
"wormhole." 3, 2, 1...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
――"Departing" "SbS"... Environment, time, 
vitals, "All Green." "Arrival" at target 
coordinates... complete.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...? I remember moving, but everything 
along the way was a blur. Yet, my luggage 
is right beside me."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Look up—
choice_data_list: （疲れてるのかな？まあいいか）

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The spring stars are "observable".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Not "Hubble." But... because of that... a 
giant constellation is "MUTX."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...We can 'observe' the 'Spring Great 
Arc'.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. A "dynamic"... 
"trajectory"... is the characteristic.
choice_data_list_en: Is that what they call the 'Great Curve'?
Is that what you mean by the 'Great Curve'?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
A "Gliese" perspective... its reception is 
"Q." Still—hearing it put that way makes 
it look that way... right?
choice_data_list: なんだかレース場のカーブみたい
choice_data_list_en: It kind of looks like a racetrack turn.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't know much about stars, but her 
explanations were fascinating despite 
being so complex. Besides, the starry sky 
is truly beautiful...
choice_data_list: I wish I could watch this forever...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The Milky Way... is easy to "observe" from 
here. Because Earth's coordinates... its 
"position"... is ideal.
choice_data_list:
Position?... Wait, you mean in outer 
space?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative... This date and time... 
Northern Hemisphere... Axial tilt, 
planetary route... both on "JST".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
So――Neo Universe and the others are 
"gazing at each other"……with the center of 
the galaxy.

Even in the galaxy, position matters, 
huh...

Even in the galaxy, position matters, 
doesn't it...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
In autumn, the moon is... "BRGT." 
Coordinate shifts, the ebb and flow of 
tides. Gravity and repulsion are... above 
all, "primitive."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Attraction and repulsion... That's all 
“FFTI”... right? That's why the cosmos, 
atomic spins, and everything...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Without this effect... it never would have 
occurred. Nor would the very concept of 
"Speed" exist.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ""Ori"... "Orion"..."
choice_data_list:
I've heard of the Orion constellation, at 
least.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Dit, dit... descend... Dah-dah-dah... 
descend. Dit, dit... 'connect' those 7 
points."
choice_data_list: オリオン座なら、聞いたことがある
choice_data_list_en: I've heard of the Orion constellation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Connecting the stars she pointed to, three 
bright stars lined up inside a quadrangle. 
It was a very easy constellation to spot.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
""Ori" is easy to understand... "ABD"... 
can "observe"... Unlike Neo Universe..."
choice_data_list: But even the hard-to-see stars are shining

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
…………Affirmative. Yeah, all fixed stars 
emit light. Silently, in "STDA"……

choice_data_list_en: Even stars that are hard to spot are still shining, though.

being so complex. Besides, the starry sky

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Negative.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer's "WORR" [mass] has already 
decreased. It will not exceed the 
"Chandrasekhar limit."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The possibility of black hole collapse 
should be gone now. "THRF"... 'It's all 
over.'

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Today... let's call it a day. Let's wrap 
things up here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sudden disbandment... She's a smart 
girl. Maybe stargazing with someone who 
can only listen to explanations was just a 
bit too boring for her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel pathetic, and kind of lonely... 
Anyway, I should walk her back to the 
dorm—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I looked back, she had already 
vanished. Leaving behind a strange 
"clatter" sound. ...My pocket feels 
strangely warm for some reason...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, a warm mini plastic 
bottle had been slipped into my pocket. As 
I grasped it, feeling returned to my 
chilled fingertips.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Only now do I notice the fatigue. I 
was stuck on my work to begin with. 
Calling it an early night felt like the 
right call."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day. When I met Neo Universe, she 
greeted me just as she always did.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Good morning"... Trainer.
choice_data_list:
Thanks for helping me take my mind off 
things yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you"... Is that being said to Neo 
Universe?
choice_data_list: 昨日は気分転換させてくれてありがとう
choice_data_list_en: Thanks for helping me clear my head yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't that she wanted to see the 
stars— she had brought me out for a change 
of pace. The early wrap-up, the warm 
drinks, everything...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
..."Scintillation". Yesterday's event and 
Neo Universe's will... I thought they were 
impossible to integrate from the "outside 
world".
choice_data_list: いろいろ気遣ってくれたよな
いろいろ気遣ってくれたよね
choice_data_list_en: They were so considerate in so many ways.
They were really considerate in all sorts of ways, weren't they?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Sfira... Sfira. Could this be... a 
"connection" too...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I feel... all fluffy inside...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt the warm, 
caring nature beneath her clumsy 
exterior...
